title: Shein reports two child labour cases in 2024 as it increased supplier audits
methodology: Article reporting disclosures made by SHEIN to a UK parliamentary committee, including two child-labour cases identified among suppliers in 2024 and supplier-audit figures.
limitations: The reported incidents are disclosures by SHEIN, relayed by Reuters; they do not establish the prevalence of child labour across the entire supply chain. The article also reports the company's response and remediation claims.
